name: guards
description: Keeps AI credit out of commits, PRs, issues, comments and releases, holds PR bodies to the PR format, and stops the streaming CI log watcher: an in-process copy of the global hook scripts in `guards/reference/`. Optionally blocks helper agents.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow: never blocks, logs what it would block (and what the guard scripts blocked) to mods-data/guards/decisions.jsonl. enforce: blocks.

attribution.title: Attribution check
attribution.description: on (the default): AI credit is kept out of commits, PRs, issues, comments and releases, as the global attribution hook keeps it out. off: the credit scan is left out. Skipped git hooks, history rewrites, --trailer, message reuse and eval stay refused either way.

helpers.title: Helper agents
helpers.description: allow (the default): guards never touches subagents, forks or workflows. block: Agent and Workflow calls are refused in enforce mode and logged in shadow mode, unless the person types /guards helpers allow in that session.
